service.name: Payments API
service.yaml:
service:
  name: Payments API
  identifier: payments_api
  serviceDefinition:
    type: Kubernetes
    spec:
      manifests:
        - manifest:
            identifier: k8s_manifests
            type: K8sManifest
            spec:
              store:
                type: Github
                spec:
                  connectorRef: account.GHConnector
                  repoName: payments-manifests
      artifacts:
        primary:
          sources:
            - identifier: acr
              type: Acr

service.name: Notifications Worker
service.yaml:
service:
  name: Notifications Worker
  identifier: notifications_worker
  serviceDefinition:
    type: Kubernetes
